The supplied native hooks preserve preview publication, snapshot and JPEG GET delegation. Synthetic composed-route regression passes.
Reverting only the three-line producer publication block restores the entire original run AST. Capture, native ownership, identity, shutdown and thread creation are unchanged.
32 waiting requests plus 64 subsequent public frame publications retain only the latest eight frame objects and one evicted object held by the active encoder. Waiters retain no retired frame object.
24 concurrent callers for one frame cause exactly one encode and share identical output bytes. Successful cache drops the BGR payload.
Wait and encode completion revalidate epoch, timestamp, revision, error and frame retirement. A queued old revision never returns a newer replacement.
Failure is cached for that frame, unlocks the encoder and permits a subsequent publication to recover. An old-frame failure does not poison the latest publication.
HTTP body hash, MIME, length, no-store and owner/frame headers match the original route for the same bytes. Snapshot preview metadata retains its three fields.
JPEG cache cannot extend the 1000ms source TTL. Visual capture still includes deferred encoding in its stricter 750ms bound. Native raw preview retains its 250ms freshness check.

memory_and_complexity.implementation: One per-state encoder mutex and per-frame cached success/failure reuse existing HTTP request threads.
memory_and_complexity.scope: These bounds cover retained raw payloads. OpenCV scratch, producer image, raw transport, Python objects and response bytes are additional. Existing ThreadingHTTPServer request-thread count is outside this payload bound.
memory_and_complexity.tradeoff: Idle native raw preview avoids eager JPEG work while retaining raw frames. JPEG demand adds encoding to HTTP latency and serializes distinct-frame encodes.

performance_interpretation.producer_metric: preview.render_encode_publish now excludes request-side JPEG encode. Its reduction alone cannot establish whole-process CPU savings.
performance_interpretation.screen_scope: Root's public synthetic screen should count producer and request-side CPU together with fixed frame supply and explicit no-demand/occasional-demand loads. Check JPEG completion age against the existing visual-capture deadline.
performance_interpretation.decision: No correctness blocker found in this local scope. Keep the separate protected-camera release contingent on measured benefit and memory cost.
